mapper.sql: sys60_file_policy_id AS file_policy_id, sys60_ext AS ext, sys60_mime_type AS mime_type, sys60_note AS note
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys60_file_policy WHERE UPPER(CONCAT(sys60_ext, sys60_mime_type, sys60_note)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY sys60_ext, sys60_mime_type, sys60_note
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys60_file_policy (sys60_file_policy_id, sys60_ext, sys60_mime_type, sys60_note) VALUES (#{id}, #{r.ext}, #{r.mimeType}, #{r.note})
